description: This Java interface 'ExpressionResolver' provides methods for resolving placeholders and executing pipeline stages within expression templates, including static methods for substitution and resolution logic.

classes.name: ExpressionResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving placeholders and executing pipeline stages in expression templates.

methods.name: resolveAsPipelineElement
methods.description: Resolves a single pipeline expression into a PipelineElement.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a complete expression template, executing placeholders and pipeline stages.
